description: WOLF v6.3 — Fully autonomous multi-strategy trading for Hyperliquid perps via Senpi MCP. Manages multiple strategies simultaneously, each with independent wallets, budgets, slots, and DSL configs. 5+N cron architecture: 5 shared wolf crons (Emerging Movers 3min, SM Flip 5min, Watchdog 5min, Risk Guardian 5min, Health Check 10min) plus one DSL v5.2 cron per strategy (native Hyperliquid SL sync via dsl-dynamic-stop-loss skill v5.3.1). Same asset can be traded in different strategies simultaneously. Enter early on first jumps, not at confirmed peaks. Dynamic risk-based leverage per strategy. Requires Senpi MCP connection, python3, mcporter CLI, OpenClaw cron system, and dsl-dynamic-stop-loss skill (provides dsl-cli.py + dsl-v5.py).
